# Tonelify

> Tonelify translates a recorded guitar tone into knob settings for the amp and
> guitar you already own. You name a song and your gear, and it returns gain,
> bass, mids, treble and presence values, a pickup position, and the effects
> chain, adapted to your rig rather than the one used on the record.

## What it does

Tonelify is a web app, not a plugin or an amp modeller. It does not process
audio. It reads the documented signal chain behind a recording and works out
where to set the controls on different equipment to land in the same place.

## Plans

- Free: 3 tone matches a month, 3 saved tones, no card required
- Week Pass: $4.99 a week, unlimited matches, no trial, renews weekly
- Player: $12.99 a month or $59.99 a year, unlimited matches, 3-day free trial

## Main pages

- [Tone library](https://tonelify.com/explore): 24 documented tones, each with the original rig
- [Tone matcher](https://tonelify.com/tone-match): enter your gear and a song, get settings
- [Pricing](https://tonelify.com/plans): plan comparison
- [Request gear](https://tonelify.com/request-gear): ask for equipment to be added

## Example tone pages

- [Master of Puppets, Metallica](https://tonelify.com/explore/master-of-puppets)
- [November Rain, Guns N' Roses](https://tonelify.com/explore/november-rain)
- [Comfortably Numb, Pink Floyd](https://tonelify.com/explore/comfortably-numb)
- [Sultans of Swing, Dire Straits](https://tonelify.com/explore/sultans-of-swing)

## Key facts

- Works with electric guitar and bass
- Covers any amp and guitar the user names, not a fixed device list
- Tone pages document the original recording rig, phrased as reported rather than confirmed
- Reviews on the site come from signed-in accounts and are not seeded
